bullets.text: Nightmare Dungeons open at Combat Levels 124, 128, 132, 136, 138, and 140. Clear all six and reach Combat Level 140 to unlock both Tower and The Frontier.
Awakening I requires Combat Level 154, all six Nightmare clears, Tower Floor 100, and 1,000 Aether. It opens Spire; preparing a run is free, while starting it spends 1 Tower Key.
Combat Levels remain uncapped. From Level 157 onward, each level grants +0.5% global damage, reaching its +50% cap at Level 256.
The intended gear route is Heroic boss gear → Nightmare gear and reforging → World Boss sidegrades up to Level 200 → Spire Divine Gear. Divine flat stats keep scaling with your highest Tower floor.

Enemy Level builds the baseline first. Boss type, Region or floor rules, affixes, Corruption or Tarot, Forge relief, and deep-pressure multipliers are then applied in that order. Percentage multipliers multiply each other; they are not simply added.

For incoming damage, mitigation level is min(attacker level, 256). Enemies at Level 256 or below use the original Defense formula unchanged. Above Level 256 only, Defense mitigation is capped at 75%; stronger enemies keep increasing their raw damage.

Incoming ability hits use only 50% of your Defense before the same mitigation formula. Armor Penetration reduces that effective Defense further, so HP, recovery, Block, Dodge, shields, and damage reduction remain important beside Defense.
Attack Interval is time between attacks: a lower number means faster attacks. Endgame effects that modify interval are multiplicative and are then held above the mode's safety floor.

Online and offline endgame combat use the same enemy Level, final Defense, mitigation, build stats, talents, subclass, Elements, Mercenary contribution, and mode modifiers. Offline progress resolves the same fight in larger time steps.
Nightmare is a fixed six-dungeon bridge, not an endless adaptive mode. Its enemies span Levels 124–142 and do not scale upward just because your character outlevels them.
For an enemy of Level L, its authored stats are scaled by: HP × [1 + 5.5% × max(0, L − 124)], Damage × [1 + 3.4% × max(0, L − 124)], and Defense × [1 + 3.2% × max(0, L − 124)].

Each dungeon contains two regular enemies and one boss. Bosses receive the global +10% boss-damage adjustment after their Nightmare scaling and use a fixed signature mechanic rather than random Tower affixes.

Later Nightmare tiers pay larger Gold, Aether, and material ranges. Bosses guarantee their main material bundles, can drop their listed class gear, and all six clears are required for the main endgame route.

On Tower Floor F, enemy level is 140 + floor((F − 1) ÷ 2). Enemy level rises once every two floors and continues scaling enemy stats, while its contribution to incoming Defense mitigation stops at Level 256.
Every 10th floor is a Boss: 6× base HP, 1.3× base Damage, and 1.3× base Defense. Every 100th floor is a Guardian and keeps those boss multipliers while using the stronger Guardian affix limits.

Regular floors and ordinary Bosses roll 2 combat affixes. Guardians roll 3. Their combined stat multipliers are capped at 1.4× HP, 1.3× Damage, and 1.4× Defense normally; Guardians cap at 1.5× HP, 1.35× Damage, and 1.5× Defense. Attack Interval is clamped to 75%–150% normally or 70%–150% for Guardians.

Base Attack Interval begins at 2,500 ms and falls by 2 ms per floor until 1,500 ms. After affixes and Corruption it can never fall below 650 ms. From Floor 200, regular encounters also contain one additional enemy.

Tower pressure rotates every 100-floor Echelon between four hazards: +20% damage taken with 15% miss chance; 0.25% max-HP drain per second with all healing blocked; −40% attack speed, +50% Mana costs, and +10% damage taken; or −25% damage, −20% critical chance, and +30% damage taken.
Deep pressure starts after Floor 200. Let P = log2(1 + (F − 200) ÷ 50). It adds min(25%, 4% × P) HP, min(15%, 2.2% × P) Damage, and min(8%, 1.2% × P) Defense.
All regeneration affixes on a Tower Boss are combined and capped at 0.25% of maximum HP per second before boss-timer Corruption pressure is applied.

A regular floor is worth 1% of the XP required for your current Combat Level; a Boss or Guardian floor is worth 3.5%. One quarter is assigned to kills and three quarters to floor completion, then equipment and talent XP bonuses apply.
Repeating below your highest floor multiplies Tower XP by 0.97 for every floor of difference. Farming your proven frontier gives full value; very low safe floors rapidly lose XP value.
Base Aether is 5 + floor(F ÷ 10). Regular floors award 1× that amount, Boss floors 5×, and Guardians 25× before Guardian Oath and Corruption reward multipliers.
Bosses award 1 Tower Key and Guardians award 2. Keys are not multiplied by Corruption and storage is capped at 10.
Your highest Tower floor synchronizes every Divine item you own. Every 100 highest floors adds one Divine Level and +50% of the item's original flat stats.

Engraving materials have small chances on regular floors, fixed bundles on Bosses, and larger fixed bundles on Guardians. Daily Tower limits are 60 Starforged Shards, 35 Engraver's Chisels, and 16 Anchoring Sigils; overflow converts to Aether.

bullets.text: Available rules are: +25% enemy HP (Weight 2), +20% enemy Damage (2), 15% shorter enemy Attack Interval (2), 50% healing (3), no Food (3), 50% Mana regeneration (2), restricted checkpoints (4), start 10 floors higher (1), 20% faster boss-pressure timers (3), and one extra floor hazard (4).
Every full 5 Corruption Weight grants +10% Gold, Aether, and non-Key Tower drops. The base reward bonus caps at +100%; partial Weight below the next group of 5 grants no partial bonus.

Steady Flame pulls numeric penalties back toward neutral by 3% per rank, up to 24% at Rank 8. It softens HP, Damage, Attack Interval, healing, Mana regeneration, and boss-timer numbers, but cannot remove no Food, the start offset, restricted checkpoints, or the extra hazard.

Checkpoints are normally secured every 25 floors. Wayfinder reduces that interval by 1 floor per rank, down to 20. Restricted checkpoints preserve the saved starting point and only allow a new secure point every second checkpoint interval.
Corruption choices are sealed for an active climb. Reward scaling affects Gold and non-Key drops only; Tower Keys remain fixed so risk cannot bypass the 10-Key cap.

title.text: Tower Corruption — Exact Risk and Reward

bullets.text: Forge Rank N costs Base Cost + (N − 1) × Cost Step. The displayed next-rank cost is authoritative, and every Forge effect is permanent for that character.

Tempered Steps has 10 ranks: each removes 2% Tower enemy HP, 1% Damage, and 2% Defense, for −20% / −10% / −20% at maximum. Guardian Oath has 5 ranks at +10% Guardian Aether each. Wayfinder has 5 ranks and changes checkpoints from every 25 floors to every 20.

Steady Flame has 8 ranks at 3% numeric Corruption relief each. Deeper Coffer has 5 ranks: each adds +1 percentage point to the reward gained per 5 Weight and +10 percentage points to its cap; at maximum, each step is +15% and the cap is +150%.
Signal Fire has 10 ranks at +5% Vanguard Aether each. Keywright has 5 ranks at +12% Tower Key progress each. Watch Rotation has 5 ranks at +5% speed to all Vanguard passive progress each.
One Vanguard band unlocks per 100 highest Tower floors, up to 5 bands. Each band holds one unlocked Mercenary and accumulates for at most 12 hours between collections.
Output factor = (1 + 4% × Mercenary Level, capped at 20) × (1 + 3% × upgrades, capped at 10) × Condition × Watch Rotation. Condition ranges from 50% to 100%.

Band B starts from (8 + 2 × B) Aether per hour and (0.015 + 0.002 × B) Tower Key progress per hour. The output factor applies to both; Signal Fire then multiplies Aether and Keywright multiplies Key progress.
Tower Key progress is fractional and carries forward. A Key is claimable each time accumulated progress reaches 1, subject to the normal 10-Key storage cap.

On Spire Floor F, enemy level is 140 + floor((F − 1) × 0.5). Regular HP uses 0.72× the level baseline; Boss HP uses 5.5×; an Aberration uses 10×. Defense uses 0.9× normally and 1.2× for Bosses and Aberrations.

Regular Damage uses 0.85× the level baseline and Boss or Aberration Damage uses 1.25×. Tarot damage relief is combined, capped at 75%, and cannot reduce the resulting multiplier below 35%; accumulated enemy-damage penalties are capped at +200%.
Every 10th floor is a Spire Boss and every 10th floor also drafts 3 Tarot cards. Attack Interval is 2,300 − 3 × F ms normally or 1,900 − 3 × F ms for Bosses, with a 900 ms floor.

Upright Tarot grants its safer run bonus and adds no Arcane Flux. Reversed Tarot grants the stronger printed bonus, adds the card's printed Flux, and also adds +3% enemy Damage. Chosen effects add together for the rest of that run.

Base Aether is 4 + floor(F ÷ 5), multiplied by 1 on a regular floor, 4 on a Boss, or 18 on an Aberration, then by Tarot Aether bonuses. At 100% Flux, the current floor becomes an Aberration and resets Flux after victory.

Aberration Divine chance follows 35%, 55%, 75%, then 100% after consecutive failures. Tarot loot bonuses multiply that chance relatively. Drops prioritize unowned class pieces; the first Divine reward prioritizes main-hand or off-hand, and duplicate protection lasts until the class set is complete.
Per-kill Combat and Hitpoints XP are capped at 1% of the current skill requirement on regular floors and 2% on Boss or Aberration floors.
Each Region contains 20 ordered nodes; Node 20 is its Boss. A route contains 6 Regions. The first route uses the original six, then each completed route draws the next six from all sixteen.
Let R be Region difficulty starting at 0, N the node from 1–20, and D completed Frontier routes. Enemy level = 140 + 6 × R + floor((N − 1) ÷ 3) + floor(1.5 × D).

Before terrain and Depth, regular HP factor = 0.86 + 0.07 × R + 0.011 × N; Boss HP starts at 1.72 instead of 0.86. Regular Damage factor = 0.90 + 0.035 × R + 0.008 × N; Boss Damage starts at 1.34. Defense starts at 0.92 normally or 1.16 for the Boss.

Each completed route adds +8% enemy HP and Defense and +5.5% enemy Damage. These Depth additions cap at +160% HP and Defense and +110% Damage. Region terrain modifiers become 1% stronger per completed route.

Node Route Aether = round[(18 + 4 × R + 2 × N) × terrain reward factor × Depth reward factor]. Terrain can add up to +25%; Depth adds +12% per completed route and caps at +150%. Region completion adds round[(220 + 55 × R) × Depth reward factor].
The original six Regions grant permanent mastery stats after their first clear. Their best-Depth value grows by +4% per additional Depth, capped at 3× the base stats.

A completed Region rolls a Region Seal at the current Depth. Seal ranks scale base stats by 1× / 1.5× / 1.83× / 2.16× / 2.49×, then rolled Depth adds +5% per Depth beyond the first, capped at 3×. Rank access is limited by clears of that Seal's Region.
Route K awards 450 + 90 × (K − 1) Route Aether and 10 Frontier Marks. Every third completed route also awards 1 Tower Key.
Only Nightmare and Divine equipment can be honed. The first rank binds one numeric stat already printed on that item. Gems, Engravings, affixes, sockets, and passive effects cannot be selected.
Every Honing rank is guaranteed and cannot downgrade, fail, or destroy the item. Nightmare equipment caps at Rank 5; Divine equipment caps at Rank 10.
Flat stats gain 2.5% of that item's current un-honed value per rank, rounded to a safe whole-number minimum. Max HP gains at least 12 per rank and Max Mana gains at least 8.

Percentage stats use stat-specific fixed increments per rank: Crit Chance +0.3 percentage points, Crit Damage +0.75, Haste +0.25, Lifesteal +0.15, Block or Dodge +0.3, Double Damage +0.2, Triple Damage +0.1, and Mana Cost or Cooldown Reduction +0.2.
A Grandworks Rebinding Chisel changes the chosen stat without losing ranks. The bonus is recalculated from the new stat using the same rule, so rebinding never duplicates the old bonus.

Divine Gear synchronizes to your highest Tower floor. Every 100 highest floors grants 1 Divine Level, adds +50% of the item's original flat stats, raises its effective item level by 50, and advances its Divine grade. Percentage stats do not receive this flat-stat multiplier.

Divine flat Attack and class primary stats keep improving auto-attacks and class Ability Power. Magic Damage improves Arcanist Ability Power only. Damaging abilities and ability DoTs retain the reduced stat-scaling slope beyond 2,000 Ability Power; healing utility remains capped at ×15 and its existing Max HP limits.

Grandworks can queue the complete Stone recipe chain or automatically gather finite available supplies before Crafting. Gathering and Crafting alternate through the normal Production queues, continue offline, and pause safely when Aether or Spire-only Aberration Shards are missing.
